title: Solving exponential and logarithmic equations
intro: Read this once before the equation quizzes. It covers both methods.

blocks.title: exponential equations
items: Same base on both sides: if $b^{x}=b^{y}$ then $x=y$
Different bases: take logarithms, $\log_b a^{r}=r\log_b a$
Write numbers as powers of one base: $9=3^{2}$, $\dfrac18=2^{-3}$

blocks.title: logarithm equations
items: Two logs with coefficient $1$: if $\log_b x=\log_b y$ then $x=y$
Combine first with the laws, then write $\log_b x=y\Rightarrow x=b^{y}$

blocks.title: always check
items: After solving a log equation, **put every answer back**: the number inside each log must be positive.
A root that makes a log argument negative or zero is **rejected**.

blocks.body: Solving $2^{x}=7$ is not a job for dividing by $2$. Take a logarithm of both sides: $x\ln2=\ln7$.

blocks.title: typed answers
blocks.body: Exact answers such as $\dfrac{\ln9}{\ln7}$ are written `ln(9)/ln(7)`. Several solutions are separated by commas, `2, -3`.
